title: The Amazon Women
summary: Hercules and Iolaus take time out from Iolaus' wedding preparations to help a distant village under attack from "monsters," who are in fact Amazonian women controlled by Hera.

title: The Lost Kingdom
summary: Hercules saves a princess from being sacrificed and they search for a missing city.

title: The Circle of Fire
sourceTitle: Hercules and the Circle of Fire
summary: Hercules and Deianeira go in search of fire to save the world from cold.

title: The Underworld
summary: Hercules is accidentally poisoned by his wife and must find a way out of the underworld.

title: The Maze of the Minotaur
sourceTitle: Hercules in the Maze of the Minotaur
summary: Hercules, settled down with his wife and children, is persuaded out of retirement to help a distant village which is being attacked by an unseen monster.

title: The Wrong Path
summary: When his stepmother Hera destroys his family, Hercules is so consumed by hatred that he loses sight of his purpose to help people in need.

title: Eye of the Beholder
summary: Hercules learns the real reason why a giant Cyclops has been terrorizing a village.

title: The Road to Calydon
summary: Hercules accompanies a town's citizens, cursed by Hera because of a theft at her temple, on a perilous journey to a city offering safe haven.

title: The Festival of Dionysus
summary: Hercules uncovers an elaborate plot calling for the murder of a king during a celebration honoring the god of wine.

title: Ares
summary: Hercules confronts his half brother Ares, the god of war, in his attempt to prevent a teen-age boy from becoming one of the evil deity's soldiers.

title: As Darkness Falls
summary: Hercules attends a friend's wedding where Nemis the Centaur arrives and kidnaps the bride and her maid of honor.

title: Pride Comes Before a Brawl
summary: Hercules' friend Iolaus fights for his life when Hera decides to punish him for an act of pride.

title: The March to Freedom
summary: Hercules saves a woman from slavery and then must help to free her fiancee from the slavers.

title: The Warrior Princess
summary: The perfect woman is waiting for Iolaus. Unfortunately, she's an evil, power-hungry warrior princess, who's using him to get Hercules out of the way.

title: Gladiator
summary: Hercules and Iolaus fight to free the slaves forced to battle to the death in a gladiatorial arena.

title: The Vanishing Dead
summary: A civil war pits brother against sister, and someone—or some nasty god—is stealing the bodies of their dead soldiers.

title: The Gauntlet
summary: Warrior princess Xena joins forces with Hercules when her troops turn on her under the command of the cruel and ruthless Darphus.

title: Unchained Heart
summary: While working together to stop the marauding Darphus, Hercules and the warrior princess Xena take their personal relationship to a new level.

title: The King of Thieves
summary: When Iolaus is falsely accused of robbery, Hercules races against time to apprehend the real thief before his friend is executed.

title: All That Glitters
summary: Hercules helps out his friend King Midas, whose gambling palace has gotten out of control with sadistic entertainment.

title: What's in a Name?
summary: A not-so-heroic Hercules imposter, hi s mortal half-brother Iphicles, is about to wed the stepdaughter of an evil warlord.

title: Siege at Naxos
summary: Hercules and Iolaus capture Goth, wanted for war crimes, but are forced to take refuge in abandoned fort while Goth's brother and his army try to rescue him.

title: Outcast
summary: Hercules helps a centaur and his family combat the prejudice of a fanatical group of townspeople seeking ethnic purity.

title: Under the Broken Sky
summary: Hercules plays Cupid to a forlorn farmer and his alluring wife, who ran away to work in a "sin bin" after the death of their two children.

title: The Mother of All Monsters
summary: Echidna, the Mother of All Monsters, is out to get Hercules for killing all her children.

title: The Other Side
summary: While trying to rescue Persephone, Hades' stolen love, Herc visits the Underworld. He's sorely tempted to stay with his beloved dead wife and children.

title: The Fire Down Below
summary: Salmoneus is set up with treasure stolen from Hera. When Hercules convinces Nemesis that Salmoneus is innocent, Hera sends a deadly creature of fire to eliminate all three of them.

title: Cast a Giant Shadow
summary: Hercules and Iolaus fall in with fellow traveler Typhon, a gentle and friendly giant. They are astounded to discover he is married to Echidna, the Mother of All Monsters.

title: Highway to Hades
summary: Hercules has an uphill battle when he goes after King Sisyphus, who's tricked a young man into taking his place in the underworld.

title: The Sword of Veracity
summary: Hercules and Iolaus search for a mystical relic that allows nothing but the truth to be uttered in its presence.

title: The Enforcer
summary: Hercules' good time at a harvest festival is interrupted by the arrival of an assassin sent by his vindictive stepmother.

title: Once a Hero
summary: Hercules and Iolaus helps Jason and the Argonauts search for the Golden Fleece.

title: Heedless Hearts
summary: Hecules is in for both love and war when he falls in love with the leader of a rebel band that is fighting a tyrant.

title: Let the Games Begin
summary: Hercules promotes peace by organizing an athletic competition between the warring Spartans and Eleans, thus creating the Olympic Games.

title: Promises
summary: Hercules and Iolaus get caught in the middle of a love triangle when they volunteer to help a king rescue his kidnapped fiancée.

title: King for a Day
summary: Iolaus discovers he has a royal look-alike and ends up helping him defend his throne from a jealous brother and a conniving general.

title: Protean Challenge
summary: A friend of Hercules and Iolaus is accused of theft when an angry god distorts reality by making people appear to have performed acts they didn't.

title: The Wedding of Alcmene
summary: The wedding of Hercules' mother to the legendary Greek hero Jason is threatened by another of Hera's plots to kill Hercules.

title: The Power
summary: Hercules intervenes when a young man with divine powers is manipulated by a relative into using his gift for villanious purposes.

title: Centaur Mentor Journey
summary: A dying centaur asks Hercules for help when a centaur group's struggle for equal rights with humans takes a violent turn.

title: The Cave of Echoes
summary: An eager young writer learns a lesson about courage when he helps Hercules and Iolaus rescue a maiden trapped in a cave.

title: Mercenary
summary: A storm at sea maroons Hercules on an island where he deals with pirates, sand monsters and a wanted killer he is transporting to Sparta.

title: Doomsday
summary: Hercules learns from a scribe, that Icarus is dead and his father, Hercules' old friend Daedalus, is being blamed.

title: Love Takes a Holiday
summary: Aphrodite, bored with her role as goddess of love, abandons it to try other activities.

title: Mummy Dearest
summary: An Egyptian princess travel to Greece to ask Hercules to find an old, walking, dangerous mummy who is being exhibited in Salmoneus' "House of Horrors".

title: Not Fade Away
summary: Iolaus will remain forever in the afterlife unless Hercules makes good on his deal with the god of the underworld to destroy Hera's latest assassin.

title: Monster Child in the Promised Land
sourceTitle: Monster Child in the Promised Land
summary: Hercules helps the monster Echidna and the giant Typhon find their kidnapped child.

title: The Green-Eyed Monster
summary: Hercules and Cupid get caught in the middle of a plot by jealous Aphrodite to marry off a mortal female whose beauty is drawing attention away from her.

title: Prince Hercules
summary: Queen Parnassa strikes Hercules with amnesia so he will believe she is his mother and agree to lead her army.

title: A Star to Guide Them
summary: Weak King Polonius receives a prophecy that a newborn baby will reign over his kingdom, and wicked Queen Maliphone convinces him to order the slaughter of all the babies in the kingdom to ensure their unborn child's succession.

title: The Lady and the Dragon
summary: A young dragon starts killing warriors and destroying villages at the same time a warlord returns from exile seeking revenge on his enemies.

title: Long Live the King
summary: Iolaus joins his look-alike cousin, King Orestes, on a dangerous diplomantic mission to ask a power-hungry ruler to support a new league of kingdoms.

title: Surprise
summary: Xena's old enemy Callisto returns from the afterlife when she makes a deal with Hera to kill Hercules in exchange for immortality.

title: Encounter
summary: Saving a beautiful creature that is part woman and part deer pits Hercules against his half brother Ares and the vengeful Prince Nestor.

title: When a Man Loves a Woman
sourceTitle: When a Man Loves a Woman
summary: When Hercules proposes to Serena, he must deal with Iolaus's disapproval, Deianeira's hurt feelings and Ares' plot to destroy the relationship.

title: Judgment Day
summary: Xena intervenes when Ares and Strife frame Hercules for the murder of someone close to him.

title: The Lost City
summary: Iolaus's search for his missing cousin Regina takes him to a commune where everyone has been brainwashed by a seemingly benevolent leader.

title: Les Contemptibles
summary: Brave Marie de Valle inspires thieves, who bear uncanny resemblances to Hercules, Iolaus and Salmoneus, to fight for the French Revolution.

title: Reign of Terror
summary: Hera plays up to Augeas's delusion that he is Zeus by giving him a taste of godly power, which he can keep if he kills Hercules.

title: The End of the Beginning
summary: Autolycus steals a powerful stone which causes Hercules to travel back in time where he meets up with his beloved Serena and the ruthless Ares.

title: War Bride
summary: When Princess Melissa is kidnapped on the eve of her wedding to Prince Gordius, Hercules must rescue her and prevent a war.

title: A Rock and a Hard Place
sourceTitle: A Rock and a Hard Place
summary: When a murder suspect escapes and flees into an old mine, only Hercules and Iolaus can keep a vengeful mob away until the crime is solved.

title: Atlantis
summary: Cassandra is a prophet without honor in her own land when she predicts that her island homeland Atlantis will be destroyed.

title: Beanstalks and Bad Eggs
summary: Hercules and Autolycus team up to rescue the caretaker of golden Harpy eggs from the clutches of a giant living in the clouds.

title: Hero's Heart
summary: When Iolaus is unable to save a woman from falling to her death, Fortune, goddess of luck, attempts to relieve his anguish by taking away his memory of everything, including Hercules.

title: Regrets... I've Had a Few
summary: Hercules reminisces about the accidental death of a childhood bully, when Celesta arrives to take the brother of the deceased boy to the Elysian Fields.

title: Web of Desire
summary: Hercules and Iolaus team up with a woman pirate to battle a queen who is now part arachnid.

title: Stranger in a Strange World
summary: Following a fierce battle with Ares, Hercules races to rescue Iolaus from a cutthroat parallel universe and save the life of his father, Zeus.

title: Two Men and a Baby
summary: After finding out he's a father, Hercules engages in a fierce battle with Ares over the life of the magically endowed baby.

title: Prodigal Sister
summary: Hercules fights members of a renegade Amazon clan to reunite a blind teenager with his sister, who is a member of the female warriors' group.

title: ...And Fancy Free
summary: In order to help a village girl, Hercules agrees to be her partner in a dance contest. They attend the dance classes of a very extravagant teacher.

title: If I Had a Hammer
summary: The blacksmith Atalanta forges a perfect likeness of Hercules, which raises havoc when it comes to life.

title: Hercules on Trial
summary: Hercules is tried for manslaughter when a man impersonating him is killed while doing a good deed.

title: Medea Culpa
summary: Hercules and Iolaus reminisce about their first battle with the fire-breathing Ghidra, the seductive powers of Medea and Hera's meddling tactics.

title: Men in Pink
summary: On the run from phony murder charges, Autolycus and Salmoneus change their names to Autolyca and Salmonella and join Widow Twanky's all-female dance troupe.

title: Armageddon Now (Part One)
summary: Hope frees Callisto and sends her back in time to keep Hercules from being born.

title: Armageddon Now (Part Two)
summary: Hope frees Callisto and sends her back in time to keep Hercules from being born.

title: Yes Virginia, There is a Hercules
sourceTitle: Yes Virginia, There is a Hercules
summary: The writers and producers of "Hercules" panic when the star of the show is nowhere to be found following an earthquake in modern day Los Angeles.

title: Porkules
summary: Discord purchases Artemis' purloined bow and, with an arrow, turns Hercules into a pig.

title: One Fowl Day
summary: Ares punishes Iolaus and Autolycus for turning Discord into a chicken by chaining them together. Hercules' pig friend fulfills her dream of becoming human.

title: My Fair Cupcake
summary: Autolycus uses the voluptuous and naive Cupcake to distract Prince Alexandros so he can steal the ruler's famous sapphire as Antioch and Carpathia ready for war.

title: War Wounds
summary: A bitter King Iphicles' actions against Grecian war veterans puts his and Iolaus's lives in danger when they are forced to battle the carnivorous sandworms.

title: Twilight
summary: Hercules reminisces about his first battle against the Parthans as he comforts his dying mother, Alcmene, and confronts his father, Zeus.

title: Top God
summary: Zeus' proposal for Hercules to join him as a god on Mount Olympus brings up memories of the warrior's first brush with divine immortality.

title: Reunions
summary: Hera blackmails Zeus into becoming mortal. Hercules battles the gods to return Alcmene's soul to the Elysian Fields and restore his father's powers.

title: Faith
summary: Hercules and Iolaus' attempt to save Sumeria from the wrath of evil deities leads to disastrous consequences.

title: Descent
summary: Consumed by grief over the loss of Iolaus, Hercules attempts to bring his best friend back from the Underworld.

title: Resurrection
summary: Hercules must fight an evil female demigod sent to destroy the Druids.

title: Genies and Grecians and Geeks, Oh My
sourceTitle: Genies and Grecians and Geeks, Oh My
summary: Autolycus and Salmoneus learn the drawbacks of stealing a magic lamp from a sultan.

title: Render Unto Caesar
summary: As Julius Caesar prepares to attack the emerald isle of Eire, Hercules helps the demigod Morrigan find the good within her.

title: Norse by Norsevest
summary: Hercules embarks on an odyssey to save the Norse god Balder from an evil prophecy.

title: Somewhere Over the Rainbow Bridge
summary: The three tragedies of Norse prophecy have occurred, and Ragnarok, the end of all things, is a certainty.

title: Darkness Rising
summary: A dark vision sends Herc from Eire to Sumeria, where Nebula is in danger

title: For Those of You Just Joining Us
sourceTitle: For Those of You Just Joining Us
summary: The writers retreat to a camp and Kevin Sorbo must rescue them from a would-be murderer without revealing his true identity as Hercules.

title: Let There Be Light
summary: Hercules, Morrigan and Nebula return to Corinth to discover the people following the cult-like form of Iolaus, who is possessed by Dahak.

title: Redemption
summary: Hercules and Zarathustra must exorcise Dahak from Iolaus' body.

title: Sky High
summary: Hercules, with the help of the Amazon Ephiny, the Centaur Nagus and a youth marked for murder, must stop a volcano from destroying the people of Mount Pelion.

title: Stranger and Stranger
summary: Hercules travels to the parallel Netherworld to rescue the gods of Olympus before both worlds are destroyed.

title: Just Passing Through
summary: Hercules reminisces about a typical day filled with desperate villagers and derring-do with his late friend, Iolaus.

title: Greece is Burning
summary: In the big city of Trendopolis, Hercules and the Widow Twanky help Althea put on a fashion show. But first, they must fend off the fashion police.

title: We'll Always Have Cyprus
summary: Morrigan joins Hercules on his mission to save the Oracle of Cyprus from predictions of her own death.

title: The Academy
summary: Hercules returns to Cheiron's academy to stop a band of renegade cadets from taking over the school.

title: Once Upon a Future King
summary: A young Merlin enlists Hercules to save Britain from a cruel and calculating tyrant—Arthur of Camelot.

title: Love on the Rocks
summary: The evil Discord tricks a mermaid into giving up her tail for legs.

title: Fade Out
summary: Hercules and Iolaus find a town where people are literally fading to death.

title: My Best Girl's Wedding
summary: Iolaus learns to his shock that his beloved Nautica is being forced into marrying the leader of a group of thugs.

title: Revelations
summary: Iolaus returns from the dead to warn Hercules that the end of the world is at hand.

title: Be Deviled
summary: Hercules meets a Serena lookalike who persuades him to help her return one of his enemies to Hades.

title: Love Amazon Style
summary: Deimos exploits a tribe of Amazons when Aphrodite accidentally puts them under a spell.

title: Rebel with a Cause
summary: Hercules and Oedipus battle the ruthless Creon to help Antigone assume her rightful position as Queen of Thebes.

title: Darkness Visible
summary: Hercules and Iolaus are asked by their old friend Vlad to fight some unusually blood-thirsty foes.

title: Hercules, Tramps & Thieves
summary: Hercules must save Autolycus from taking the rap for a bank robbery his ex-wife committed.

title: City of the Dead
summary: Hercules and Iolaus also travel to Egypt on a diplomatic mission only to become embroiled in a royal family feud that threatens the life of Queen Nefertiti.

title: A Wicked Good Time
summary: A witch in training frames Hercules as an evil warlock and casts a love spell on Iolaus.

title: Full Circle
summary: The fate of the world rests with Hercules when Zeus releases Hera from the Abyss of Tartarus and inadvertently lets loose the Titans.
